text:
```yaml
name: Flaky Monitor Reporter

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  report:
    name: Generate Flaky Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'failure' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download workflow run artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-test-results
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install flaky-monitor
        run: cargo install flaky-monitor --locked

      - name: Generate Report
        env:
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          COMMIT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        run: |
          if [ -d "flaky-test-results" ]; then
            flaky-monitor report \
              --input-dir flaky-test-results \
              --output report.md \
              --repo "$REPO" \
              --commit "$COMMIT"
          else
            echo "No flaky test results found." > report.md
          fi

      - name: Upload Report Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: report.md

      - name: Comment on PR
        if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0] != null }}
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: Flaky Test Report
          path: report.md
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
